metadata.question: Was the sulfer dioxide concentration higher over Cumbre Vieja than the Funchal Island on October 18, 2021?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Primary: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2 on 2021-10-18 (end exclusive 2021-10-19), over two 20 km buffers:
  - Cumbre Vieja (La Palma): [28.57, -17.86]
  - Funchal (Madeira): [32.65, -16.91]
- Fallbacks: COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_SO2; if still empty, widen to 2021-10-17 to 2021-10-20.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask using qa_value >= 0.5. Cloud is not the question; cloud_fraction will be reported for validation but not used to mask further to avoid losing pixels.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collections empty after fallbacks: C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either ROI: C2.
- If mean value is null or NaN: C3.
- Otherwise compare means: higher over Cumbre Vieja => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const cvPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-17.86, 28.57]); // Cumbre Vieja, La Palma
    const fuPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-16.91, 32.65]); // Funchal, Madeira
    const bufferMeters = 20000;
    const cvGeom = cvPoint.buffer(bufferMeters);
    const fuGeom = fuPoint.buffer(bufferMeters);

    const dayStart = '2021-10-18';
    const dayEnd = '2021-10-19'; // end exclusive
    const wideStart = '2021-10-17';
    const wideEnd = '2021-10-20';

    // 2. Helper to find a valid collection
    async function findCollection(start, end) {
      const ids = ['COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_SO2', 'COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_SO2'];
      for (const id of ids) {
        const col = ee.ImageCollection(id).filterDate(start, end);
        const size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size > 0) return { id, col, size, start, end };
      }
      return null;
    }

    let found = await findCollection(dayStart, dayEnd);
    if (!found) {
      found = await findCollection(wideStart, wideEnd);
    }
    if (!found) {
      console.log('Images: 0');
      console.log('No images found in date/location.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: mask by qa_value >= 0.5; ensure cloud band exists
    function prep(img) {
      const bands = img.bandNames();
      const hasQA = bands.contains('qa_value');
      const hasCF = bands.contains('cloud_fraction');

      const qa = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasQA, img.select('qa_value'), ee.Image.constant(1)));
      const mask = qa.gte(0.5);

      const so2 = img.select('SO2_column_number_density').updateMask(mask).rename('so2');
      const cf = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(hasCF, img.select('cloud_fraction'), ee.Image.constant(0)))
        .updateMask(mask)
        .rename('cloud');

      return so2.addBands(cf).copyProperties(img, img.propertyNames());
    }

    const colMasked = found.col.map(prep);
    const img = colMasked.mean();

    // 4. Calculation: counts and means per ROI
    async function statsFor(geom) {
      const count = await img.select('so2').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('so2').getInfo();

      const meanSO2 = await img.select('so2').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('so2').getInfo();

      const meanCloud = await img.select('cloud').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      }).get('cloud').getInfo();

      return { count, meanSO2, meanCloud };
    }

    const cv = await statsFor(cvGeom);
    const fu = await statsFor(fuGeom);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`Product: ${found.id}`);
    console.log(`Date Window: ${found.start} to ${found.end} (Images: ${found.size})`);

    // Check C2 (no valid pixels)
    const cvCount = Number(cv.count) || 0;
    const fuCount = Number(fu.count) || 0;
    if (cvCount === 0 || fuCount === 0) {
      console.log(`Cumbre Vieja Pixels: ${cvCount}, Funchal Pixels: ${fuCount}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    const cvVal = cv.meanSO2;
    const fuVal = fu.meanSO2;
    const cvCloud = cv.meanCloud;
    const fuCloud = fu.meanCloud;

    // Check C3 (null/NaN)
    const invalid = (v) => v === null || Number.isNaN(v) || !Number.isFinite(v);
    if (invalid(cvVal) || invalid(fuVal)) {
      console.log(`CV SO2: ${cvVal}, FU SO2: ${fuVal}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Cumbre Vieja - SO2 mean: ${cvVal.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2, Pixels: ${cvCount}, Cloud: ${cvCloud !== null ? cvCloud.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Funchal      - SO2 mean: ${fuVal.toExponential(3)} mol/m^2, Pixels: ${fuCount}, Cloud: ${fuCloud !== null ? fuCloud.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);

    // Compare
    if (cvVal > fuVal) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // In case of API/band/method/memory errors
    // Uncomment next line for debugging logs:
    // console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
